startingLoadChecks.scope: Shared domain on synthetic records; no physical device or rendering claim.

Actual recent matching weight is offered as a reference without filling any targets
Changed reps, sets, role and source stage never qualify as matching history
Latest partial, concern, missing-feedback, assisted and unequal-load records block older successes
Stale and future history does not establish a baseline
History, setup, caps and custom exercise changes invalidate an existing review
Equipment limits reject impossible weights with the original state and preview kept
Nonopening sessions, duplicate selections and unconfigured fields are rejected
Tampered numeric targets remain rejected even when a display signature is rewritten

Native shared entrypoint applies the same first-only and stale-history boundaries
